name: Explicit Volumetric Rendering with Multiple View Aggregation
definition: A method that models scene geometry and appearance as an explicit RGBα volume V to amortize rendering across views, avoiding per-ray sampling independence issues of NeRF-like methods.
summary: Explicit Volumetric Rendering with Multiple View Aggregation models scenes as an explicit RGBα volume to amortize rendering across views, enabling real-time performance and structural losses unlike implicit NeRF methods.
